goal.en: In a fresh short text, the learner can locate requested personal details without answer-revealing support.
goal.ar: أن تجد البيانات الشخصية المطلوبة في بطاقة أو نبذة قصيرة من غير ترجمة كل النص.

scope.performance: retrieve requested values from two changed layouts

video.english_pronunciation: General American with inline SSML IPA

variants.teach_back: Explain why a correct value from the wrong field is still incorrect.

privacy: The learner may use fictional safe information.
No microphone permission or raw-answer retention is required.
accessibility: Every spoken model has visible text.
Colour is never the only feedback signal.
Arabic and English reading directions are explicit.

bounded_scope_notes: Recognise personal-detail labels and retrieve the value attached to each one.
Distinguish first name, last name, address, and email address.
Preserve left-to-right order in English names, email addresses, and numbers.
